title: Monitoring plan.
officialText:
Where monitoring is required by Section 3309, such monitoring shall be in accordance with a monitoring
plan developed by a registered design professional and acceptable to the commissioner. The monitoring plan shall be specific to the
structures to be monitored and operations to be undertaken, and shall specify the scope and frequency of monitoring, acceptable
tolerances, and reporting criteria for when tolerances are exceeded.
SECTION BC 3310
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OR
DEMOLITION OF MAJOR BUILDINGS
